page.layout: One printed page of digitiser's cover sheet: e-rara logo at top right; title block centred (www.e-rara.ch, title, author, place and year, library, shelf mark, persistent link); below a rule, a four-language description of e-rara.ch; below a second rule, four-language terms of use; Visual Library logo at bottom right.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not part of the book. Its content is not transcribed: the logos, banner, links and terms of use are excluded under the rules. The book's own title, as given on the sheet, is "Theses theologicae de versione bibliorum in linguas vernaculas", by Kaspar Waser, Tiguri (Zürich), anno 1616, held by the Zentralbibliothek Zürich, shelf mark 6.122,5.
